realEpisodes.prefixPolicy: original public BFS teacher, applied from fresh seed reset to anchor, prefix replayed byte-identically across 3 arms
realEpisodes.followup: same original public BFS teacher for ALL arms after one intervened action; this common future policy sees full public grid, hence claims no direct R5 effect
realEpisodes.positiveReturn: actual original environment cumulative source reward after intervention (including first action) with future step-discount gamma=0.97 and per-step -0.01, no rewards for unplayed branches except separately executed paired interventions

methodology.modelPredictor: F7 original clipped delta x/y, public heading, blocked, selected action, family; same 32-count FIT-return shrinkage and gamma=.97 stepCost=.01
methodology.conventionalFITReturnBaseline: trained family+action mean return from identical F7 FIT
methodology.conventionalSourceModel: fully FIT-learned six-public-field action-conditioned transition model from identical public stream, choose legal action minimizing estimated goal Manhattan distance with turns and blocked risk, no privileged grid
methodology.expert: unmodified original full-public-grid BFS, reported separately as more informed and common continuation
methodology.policyDecision: for every anchored public observation choose argmax predicted FIT-return among all 3 actions, deterministic tie lowest action
methodology.determinism: for each anchor and action make an entirely new real MiniGrid environment via same seed, replay identical prefix actions, assert exact public six fields and original public state grid SHA match all arms
